subject: Elara renewal: sprint commit scaling & rate carve-out proposal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Gardner <sam@elara.com>, Diana Cruz <diana.cruz@elara.com>
Cc: procurement@elara.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Elara renewal: sprint commit scaling & rate carve-out proposal

Hi Sam / Diana,

Great to connect last week — thanks for walking us through the projected Q3 traffic spike. Per our discussion, I put together a short proposal to lock in a higher committed throughput for your Hosted API (monthly commit) while protecting you from short-term bursts via a carve-out bucket. Key points: 

- Proposed monthly commit: 18M tokens/month (up from 8M)
- Tiered rate: base per-token rate for committed usage, burst rate for carve-out bucket capped at 5x the base token price
- Soft throttle window: 12-hour smoothing window to avoid sudden throttling for transient spikes
- Term: 12 months with an option to annualize pricing at month 7 if usage stabilizes

I attached a draft SOW and a pricing sheet for your review. If this looks reasonable, we can route to procurement for PO/DocuSign and schedule an ops handoff call with our Dedicated/Hosted onboarding engineer.

Attaching: [Attachment: Redwood-Elara-SOW-Apr2026.docx (docx)] [Attachment: elara-pricing-sheet-Apr2026.pdf (pdf)]

Next steps: can you confirm (1) whether the proposed committed token level covers your baseline for Q3, and (2) whether procurement prefers a PO-first flow or DocuSign?

Thanks — cheers,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[redwood.ai]

From: Sam Gardner <sam@elara.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Diana Cruz <diana.cruz@elara.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elara renewal: sprint commit scaling & rate carve-out proposal

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear proposal. A few items from our side: 

1) The 18M looks like the right floor for Q3 given our marketing push, but we may need a temporary uplift during the product launch week (we expect a ~2.5x delta for ~10 days).
2) The carve-out bucket concept is good. Can you confirm the burst bucket refill/reset cadence (daily vs monthly)?
3) Procurement prefers DocuSign for signatures but will need a PO number for invoicing. They can sign through DocuSign and then raise a PO referencing the signed agreement.

If you can tweak the SOW to call out a 10-day launch uplift allowance (with an explicit overage calculation) and clarify burst reset cadence, we should be good to move to legal/procurement.

Sam Gardner
Head of Product, Elara Systems

Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Elara renewal: sprint commit scaling & rate carve-out proposal

Karthik / Marissa — looping you both in. Sam confirmed the floor and asked for two clarifications that legal/procurement will need: burst bucket reset cadence and explicit 10-day uplift allowance handling.

Proposed internal ask:
- Set burst bucket to daily refill up to the carve-out cap (so we don't allow long multi-day debt), but allow a one-time 10-day launch uplift where overage is billed at the burst rate with a capped maximum.
- Offer a small launch credit (one-time) of 10% of estimated overage to reduce friction for the product launch.

Can legal & pricing confirm whether we can structure the DocuSign agreement with a clause: \"Launch uplift allowance: one-time 10-day temporary uplift; overage billed at burst rate up to X; Redwood will provide a one-time credit equal to 10% of billed overage.\"

Attaching internal note: [Attachment: internal-ops-note.txt (txt)]

Soojin

Hi Soojin / Sam,

Thanks — procurement has reviewed the draft SOW and pricing sheet. We can proceed with DocuSign for signature and will issue a PO referencing the executed agreement. A couple of amendments we need in the final SOW: 

- Add explicit billing line for the one-time launch credit and mechanics for applying it to the first invoice.
- Clarify the burst reset cadence as \"daily refill at 00:00 UTC\" and include the formula for overage calculation (burst_rate * tokens_over_carveout).
- Please include Redwood's standard SOC2 audit clause and data retention appendix (we'll attach our security addendum separately).

If you can incorporate those three items and resend the DocuSign packet, procurement will prepare a PO immediately upon receipt of the signed agreement.

Best,
Procurement Team
Elara Systems
